heading: Request Correlation with `X-Exchange-Id`
proposed: The request id is put into the logging context on receive and never removed, so a reused worker thread can log an earlier request's id. To find a failing request, match the X-Exchange-Id response header, not the id shown on nearby log lines.

heading: REST Wire Contract
proposed: The default java.util.Date parser in the runtime is one shared SimpleDateFormat, so parallel requests can parse a date wrongly or fail. Until fixed, send dates in a JSON request body rather than as query or path parameters on busy endpoints.

heading: Surviving Regeneration: checksum ignore and normalisation
proposed: .generator-ignore has no negation. Each line is a glob on the file path, so a line starting with "!" does not re-include a file. A file is excluded when any .generator-ignore from its folder up to the project root matches, and a child folder cannot override a parent rule. Narrow the broader pattern instead of negating it.
